data.description: The Hills sets itself apart with its seamless blend of luxury and convenience!

data.answer: Residents enjoy a sophisticated lifestyle with access to world-class amenities, while the strategic location provides easy connectivity to major attractions and business hubs in Dubai. The combination of high-end living spaces and an ideal location makes The Hills a sought-after destination for those looking to experience the best of Dubai.

The Hills features two residential mid-rise buildings, complemented by the Vida Hotel and the Vida Residence, which offer serviced residential hotel apartments. Investors highlight The Hills' prime location as a major selling point, providing excellent connectivity to many of Dubai's tourist and business hotspots. Moreover, the easy commute to other cities via the E11 highway, which connects all of the UAE, is another significant advantage.


The residential area is divided into three sections: The Hills A, The Hills C, and Vida Residence. The apartments are available in 1, 2, and 3-bedroom layouts. These flats provide stunning views of Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT), the lush greenery of the Emirates Golf Club, and the Emirates Living communities, including The Meadows and The Lakes.

Buying a Property in The Hills

Looking for properties for sale in Dubai? Investors and prospective property buyers can consider The Hills for its luxury and spacious apartments. Anticipate a minimum price of AED 980k for a 1-bedroom flat, AED 1.3M for a 2-bedroom apartment, and AED 2.3M for a 3-bedroom flat in The Hills. Moreover, there are newly available apartments in The Hills offering various bedroom configurations.

Rental Properties in The Hills

Searching for rental apartments in Dubai? With freehold apartments available, residents have the option to rent or own their flats in the area. Rental prices for a 1-bedroom apartment in The Hills range from AED 70k to AED 135k annually. Larger 2-bedroom apartments typically rent for an average of AED 125k per year, while 3-bedroom apartments are priced at AED 138k and above per annum.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in The Hills?

data.answer:
Living in The Hills offers a blend of luxury and convenience. Residents enjoy a sophisticated lifestyle with access to world-class amenities, lush green landscapes, and scenic views of the Emirates Golf Club. The community is family-friendly, featuring various recreational facilities, parks, and fitness centers. The strategic location along Sheikh Zayed Road provides easy connectivity to Dubai's major attractions, business hubs, and entertainment centers, making it a sought-after destination for both families and professionals.

Public Transportation in The Hills 

You can easily access the area via Sheikh Zayed Road. If you want to use public transportation, the nearest option is the Mall of the Emirates Metro Station, 9 minutes away from the area. Once you hop off the station, you can take a taxi or a ride-hailing service to reach The Hills. Regarding parking, residents have access to dedicated spaces within the residential buildings. Visitors will need to use street parking.

Supermarkets in The Hills 

To enhance residents' convenience, numerous supermarkets are located near The Hills. Many of these are situated in the JLT community, including multiple branches of Al Maya Supermarket, Carrefour Market, and a Spinneys supermarket. Additionally, Fresh Berry Supermarket and West Zone Supermarket are slightly further away but still within a 10-minute drive.

Schools and Nurseries Near The Hills

The Hills is surrounded by several reputable schools and nurseries, making it an ideal location for families with children. Nearby educational institutions include Dubai International Academy (DIA), which is approximately 10 minutes away and offers the International Baccalaureate (IB) curriculum. 

Emirates International School Meadows, located about 15 minutes away, also provides the IB curriculum. Regent International School, situated around 12 minutes away, follows the British curriculum. For early childhood education, Raffles Nursery in The Lakes is just a 5-minute drive away.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near The Hills

The Hills offers proximity to various places of worship to cater to different faiths. Several mosques are within a short drive, including the Al Rahim Mosque in JBR, which is around 10 minutes away. 

The closest churches are the Dubai Evangelical Church Centre and St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church, both located in Jebel Ali and approximately 15 minutes away. For Hindu worshippers, the Hindu Temple in Bur Dubai is about 30 minutes away.

Clinics and Hospitals Near The Hills

Residents of The Hills have access to high-quality healthcare facilities within a short drive. Mediclinic Meadows is approximately 10 minutes away, offering a range of medical services. Al Zahra Hospital, about 15 minutes away, is a well-equipped hospital providing comprehensive healthcare services.

Emirates Hospital Clinics in Dubai Marina, located around 10 minutes away, offers various specialist services. Saudi German Hospital, roughly 20 minutes away, is known for its extensive medical facilities and specialist care.

The Hills  Location & Nearby Areas

The Hills boasts a prime location along Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), providing residents with convenient access to many of Dubai’s key areas and attractions. The community is nestled amidst the bustling urban landscape, yet it offers a tranquil living environment with stunning views of the Emirates Golf Club. Nearby areas include Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT), just a few minutes' drive away, known for its high-rise towers, dining options, and recreational facilities. Dubai Marina, approximately 10 minutes away, is a popular destination for its waterfront lifestyle, shopping, dining, and entertainment options. 

Palm Jumeirah, around 15 minutes away, offers luxury hotels, beachfront living, and a variety of leisure activities. Emirates Living Communities, including The Meadows, The Lakes, and The Springs, are within a short drive and provide additional residential options and amenities. 

Downtown Dubai, about 20 minutes away, is home to the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and numerous dining and entertainment venues. The Hills’ strategic location along Sheikh Zayed Road ensures that residents can easily commute to other parts of Dubai and the UAE, making it an attractive choice for both families and professionals.

more_info.question: Things to Do in The Hills

data.answer:
The Hills offers a variety of recreational and leisure activities for residents. The community is centered around the lush landscapes of the Emirates Golf Club, providing a serene environment for golfing enthusiasts. Additionally, residents can enjoy walking and jogging paths, fitness centers, and parks within the neighborhood. The proximity to Dubai Marina and Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT) means that world-class dining, shopping, and entertainment options are just a short drive away.

Shopping Malls in and Near The Hills Area

Residents of The Hills have easy access to several shopping destinations. Dubai Marina Mall is approximately 10 minutes away, offering a range of retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment facilities, including a cinema. 
The Mall of the Emirates, located about 15 minutes away, is another popular shopping destination featuring a wide variety of stores, a ski slope, and numerous restaurants. For everyday shopping needs, the nearby Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT) and The Springs Souk provide convenient options with supermarkets, cafes, and essential services.

Restaurants in The Hills

The Hills and its surrounding areas offer a diverse selection of dining options. Within the community, residents can enjoy the dining establishments at the Vida Hotel, which features a range of international cuisines. Nearby Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT) is renowned for its eclectic mix of restaurants, offering everything from casual cafes to fine dining. Dubai Marina also boasts a vibrant culinary scene with waterfront restaurants and trendy eateries.

Beaches Near The Hills

For those who enjoy beachside relaxation, The Hills is conveniently located near several beautiful beaches. JBR Beach is approximately 10 minutes away, offering a lively atmosphere with a range of beachside activities, dining options, and retail outlets. Kite Beach, about 20 minutes away, is another popular spot known for its vibrant beach culture, water sports, and food trucks. The iconic Palm Jumeirah also offers pristine beaches and luxurious beach clubs, providing an ideal getaway for residents.

Hotels in The Hills

The Hills is home to the luxurious Vida Hotel, which offers a blend of comfort and elegance, perfect for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel features contemporary rooms, a variety of dining options, and state-of-the-art amenities, including a fitness center and swimming pool. 

Guests can enjoy stunning views of the Emirates Golf Club and easy access to nearby attractions. The Hills' proximity to Dubai Marina and JLT means that several other high-end hotels are just a short drive away, offering more accommodation options for visitors.

Attractions and Landmarks In and Near The Hills, Dubai

The Hills is strategically located near several of Dubai’s key attractions and landmarks. The Emirates Golf Club, right within the community, is a major highlight, offering world-class golfing facilities and lush green landscapes. Just a short drive away, residents and visitors can explore Dubai Marina, known for its stunning waterfront, luxury yachts, and vibrant nightlife.

The iconic Palm Jumeirah, with its luxury resorts and entertainment venues, is also nearby. For those interested in shopping and entertainment, the Mall of the Emirates and Dubai Marina Mall are easily accessible. The close proximity to Sheikh Zayed Road ensures that other major attractions, such as the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, are within a convenient driving distance.

Outdoor Activities, Salons, and Gyms

The Hills provides ample opportunities for outdoor activities and fitness. The community features scenic walking and jogging paths, parks, and fitness centers, promoting an active lifestyle. Residents can also enjoy the facilities at the Emirates Golf Club, including tennis courts and a state-of-the-art gym. 

For beauty and wellness services, several salons and spas are available within and around The Hills. The Vida Hotel offers luxurious spa treatments, while nearby JLT and Dubai Marina have numerous salons and wellness centers catering to a variety of needs. Additionally, fitness enthusiasts can explore the many gyms and yoga studios in the surrounding areas, ensuring that all wellness and fitness requirements are met.
There are only apartments in the community. Those looking for villas or townhouses can check out the neighboring communities, like The Meadows and Emirates Hills.

Are the Emirates Hills and The Hills the same?

Emirates Hills and The Hills are not the same, although both are prestigious developments by Emaar Properties. Emirates Hills is an exclusive, gated community known for its opulent villas and mansions. The Hills, on the other hand, is a more recent development launched in 2013 and consists of low-rise apartments.

What types of properties are available in The Hills?

The Hills offers a range of apartments, including 1, 2, and 3-bedroom configurations. The community also includes the Vida Residence, which provides serviced residential hotel apartments.

What amenities are available in The Hills?

Residents of The Hills can enjoy various amenities, including swimming pools, fitness centers, children's play areas, and landscaped gardens. The community also features the luxurious Vida Hotel, which offers additional dining and recreational options.

What are the views like from the apartments in The Hills?

Apartments in The Hills offer scenic views of the Emirates Golf Club, Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT), and the surrounding Emirates Living communities such as The Meadows and The Lakes.

Is The Hills a freehold community?

Yes, The Hills is a freehold community, allowing residents to rent or own their flats in the area.

What are the nearby attractions and landmarks?

The Hills is conveniently located near several key attractions, including Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT), Palm Jumeirah, and Downtown Dubai. It is also close to major shopping destinations like Dubai Marina Mall and Mall of the Emirates.

data.content:
The Hills is a project by Emaar Properties that was launched in 2013. The community has low- and mid-rise apartment buildings boasting breathtaking views of the Emirates Golf Club. Moreover, there is a hotel in the community, the Vida Hotel, offering serviced apartments. The luxury properties in The Hills are in high demand among sellers and renters.

The Hills is an exceptional development at a prime location along the Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) highway. Amenities in The Hills are top-notch, including swimming pools, fitness centers, and beautifully landscaped green spaces. The community also hosts retail and dining options, ensuring convenience and leisure are always at hand.

The Hills Emaar provides easy access to Dubai’s business districts and leisure attractions. It’s an ideal choice for families and professionals looking for an upscale, peaceful living environment within the vibrant city of Dubai.
